# polaris_principal_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a Polaris principal role to a principal identity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_principal_role_assignment" "john_engineers" {
  principal_name      = polaris_principal.data_engineer.name
  principal_role_name = polaris_principal_role.data_engineers.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_name` (String) The name of the principal receiving the role.
- `principal_role_name` (String) The name of the principal role to assign.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite identifier of the assignment in format `principal_name/principal_role_name`.
